hypothesis: A proposed skip can start too late when a unique ayah just before its start is counted as read only because a refrain word after it is bound to the source. In p24, 26:130 is never heard, but the warning fires at 26:131:2 and the real skip at 26:130:1 is missed. Re-decide the skip's start with a closed forward-sum fit that compares reading the adjacent whole ayah against skipping it. Predict checker -2 (the p24 miss and false-warning pair), overall -3; the third call, a p26 41:19:7 edge fix, is speculative and the floor is -2.
